q: Is memory ingestion a push (caller submits) or a pull (system watches a source)?
a: both, with the watcher primary — watch_folder polls a directory (agent.py:535) and POST /ingest exists (agent.py:613).

q: Does the system accept any modality, or only the modality it can reason about carefully?
a: 27 extensions across text/image/audio/video/PDF (agent.py:42–68).

q: Is raw input retained, or only the derived representation?
a: both — raw_text and summary are separate columns (agent.py:87–88), and the ingest prompt tells the model to put its own full description into raw_text (agent.py:334)

q: Is a memory a typed record or an untyped blob with tags?
a: untyped. One flat row with entities/topics as free-text JSON arrays (agent.py:89–90).

q: Is confidence/salience a scalar, a category, or absent?
a: a scalar — importance REAL DEFAULT 0.5 (agent.py:93), assigned by the model from a one-line instruction (agent.py:330).

q: Where do relations live — in the schema or in the text?
a: in a JSON blob appended to both endpoints of the edge (agent.py:210–222).

q: What is dropped at ingest, and is the drop recorded?
a: text truncated at 10 000 characters (agent.py:557); media over 20 MB skipped (agent.py:509–511).

q: On re-ingesting the same content, does the system dedupe, version, or duplicate?
a: duplicate.

q: When new information contradicts old, what happens?
a: nothing. Both rows persist; the query agent resolves the contradiction in prose, or doesn't.

q: Is deletion real deletion?
a: yes — DELETE FROM memories WHERE id = ?

q: How is relevant memory found — search, embedding, or "read everything"?
a: read everything.

q: Is retrieval separable from disclosure?
a: the question is not present. One path, one audience; everything retrieved is available to the answer.

q: Are consolidations a separate retrieval tier?
a: yes — read_consolidation_history is a distinct tool (agent.py:231, wired at :372) returning the last 10.

q: Does the caller get memories or an answer?
a: an answer, with [Memory N] citations requested by prompt (agent.py:369) — therefore not guaranteed, not validated, not resolvable to a row by any code.

q: Is the HTTP surface authenticated?
a: no. Binds 0.0.0.0 (agent.py:688) with no auth, no CORS policy, no rate limit, and a /clear endpoint that wipes the DB and the user's files.

q: On extraction failure, is the input retried, quarantined, or dropped?
a: dropped. The try around ingestion logs and continues (agent.py:562–564), and the processed_files insert runs outside that try (agent.py:565), so a failed file is permanently marked

q: What happens when the model doesn't call the tool?
a: nothing happens and nobody knows.

q: Is low confidence represented at all?
a: no. importance is salience, not confidence, and nothing abstains.

q: Does memory decay, expire, or accumulate forever?
a: accumulate forever.

q: Is consolidation a one-way ratchet?
a: yes. consolidated flips 0→1 (agent.py:224) and nothing flips it back.

q: When does consolidation run — on volume, on time, or on demand?
a: a fixed timer (agent.py:582) gated by a count check (>= 2, agent.py:591), plus manual POST /consolidate (agent.py:635).

q: What is assumed idempotent?
a: Schema creation genuinely is (agent.py:84); file processing is made idempotent by path (agent.py:549), a weaker guarantee than content-idempotency; store_memory is not idempotent and has no

q: What is assumed ordered?
a: created_at DESC as ISO-8601 TEXT (agent.py:156) — correct only because the format is lexically sortable and always UTC (agent.py:136), an unstated invariant no test protects.

q: Is concurrent access considered?
